Nagaland Assembly Seeks Withdrawal of PAP Regime

The Nagaland Legislative Assembly has unanimously passed a resolution urging the central government to withdraw the Protected Area Permit (PAP) regime. The resolution calls for the replacement of the PAP system with a new framework. The assembly's decision reflects a desire for a different governance model in the state, particularly in Eastern Nagaland, which has historically sought its own governance structure.
